summary: BILBERGERN OPPDAL AS (org. no. 837 323 762) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oppdal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-03-10. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 52.219 (Tjenester tilknyttet landtransport ikke nevnt annet sted). Board chair: Jan Inge Stenberg.
